purpose: Scoped controlled-character spatial freeze for external full-body playback
evidence_scope: offline current saved PE; no native calls or live state edits performed

preferred_runtime_candidate.method: virtual SetMovementMode(MOVE_None=0, Custom=0) on validated controlled pawn CharacterMovementComponent

windows_x64_abi.declaration: void (*)(void* movement_component, uint32_t movement_mode, uint8_t custom_mode)

preferred_runtime_candidate.thread_requirement: Known game thread outside current movement update/physics task; keep the mesh publication callback running
side_effects: SetMovementMode writes MovementMode and CustomMovementMode then dispatches OnMovementModeChanged when valid data is present.
MOVE_None path calls StopMovementImmediately via slot 0x478 and clears movement input/acceleration through slot 0x568.
Velocity +0xd4 is replaced with zero and mirrored into UpdatedComponent +0x160 through UpdateComponentVelocity slot 0x4b8.
Acceleration +0x3ec and internal vector +0x5e0 are cleared; flag +0x5c8 bit 0x02 is cleared.
OnMovementModeChanged clears floor/base state, notifies owner through slots 0x8c8 and 0x950, and resets force/impulse vectors +0x434/+0x440/+0x604 via slot 0x780.
Async mode changes may be queued in component state +0x390; all queued/native/network side effects are not captured by a two-byte snapshot.

before_activation: Validate controlled pawn object identity/serial/class, mesh owner relationship, CharacterMovement pointer +0x318, reciprocal CharacterOwner +0x168 and PawnOwner +0x150, UpdatedComponent and Actor RootComponent relationship.
Read the current live vtable target at movement vtable +0x5f0 and validate executable bytes against the current module; static base vtable is evidence only.
Snapshot original mode/custom mode, velocity, acceleration, known force vectors, relevant tick/input state and current actor world anchor before any mutation.
Reject nonfinite vectors and object/session identity changes. A grounded idle activation avoids inventing restoration of active jumps/root-motion/async movement jobs.
Assign a session token; no unrelated component, Actor tick, animation mode or global clock is changed.
active: Call the validated native virtual setter once on the known game thread with mode 0/custom 0, then read back both mode bytes and record post-call velocity/acceleration/force state.
Keep native mesh animation/publication active so external post-FK playback and its stop/restore path continue to execute.

Monitor controlled pawn/mesh/component serials, mode state and actor world anchor. External engine/game/network changes can still move the actor; do not report guaranteed spatial immobility from this setter alone.
Do not repeatedly overwrite a new movement mode from another engine owner. Identity/mode conflict ends playback and begins scoped restoration.
stop_or_failure: Stop new pose publications and restore final pose/prop layers through their existing exact-byte scoped restore path.
On the same surviving controlled component and game thread, restore original MovementMode/CustomMovementMode through the same validated setter only if the freeze session still owns the frozen mode.

If preserving captured idle dynamics is part of the selected policy, restore owned velocity/acceleration/force fields only while they still match this session's observed forced state; update the UpdatedComponent velocity mirror consistently.

Do not memcpy the whole CharacterMovementComponent or pretend native floor/base/async queues can be rolled back by a byte copy. Native setter recomputes current movement state and can notify other systems.
Read back restoration and retain a pending restore record on uncertainty. No cleanup against a replaced object/address/serial and no successful-restore claim without verification.
A control path independent of potentially disabled mesh callbacks is required before disabling animation or its tick; the preferred candidate avoids doing so.

DisableMovement.behavior: With CharacterOwner present, delegates to SetMovementMode(0,0); absent owner path directly writes mode word zero.
DisableMovement.reason_not_needed: SetMovementMode provides explicit symmetric original-mode restore.

SetComponentTickEnabled.reason_not_default: Movement tick pause preserves mode but does not cover independent physics, post-physics/async updates or external root writers; disabling mesh tick can stop publication.

SetActorTickEnabled.reason_not_default: Actor primary tick is distinct from movement/mesh component ticks and is too broad to infer a reliable local spatial freeze.

bPauseAnims.generated_setter_behavior: or byte ptr [rcx+0xcb9],2; one-way construction bit setter, not a reversible runtime pause API
bPauseAnims.proven: bPauseAnims mask 2 causes ShouldTickPose to return false; ordinary tick branch bypasses TickPose slot 0xa98.
bPauseAnims.unknown: Some finalize/publication routes may still occur, but complete callback cadence and cleanup liveness after pause have not been established.
bPauseAnims.reason_not_default: Pausing source animation may suppress the exact publication callback needed for external playback and scoped restoration.

integration_state: Contract and binary witnesses delivered; root callback/game implementation not edited by this audit
limitations: Static base class function and property facts do not identify live controlled pawn/subclass lifetime or thread phase.
Network corrections, external actor transform setters and Kuro movement extensions can override MOVE_None; monitor observed world anchor.
Exact pre-freeze native movement engine state restoration is not proven; symmetric mode restoration and explicitly owned scalar/vector restoration must be distinguished from whole-state rollback.
No anti-cheat, integrity, authentication, or remote code mechanisms were investigated or altered.
